description.fr: Elle émet de magnifiques reflets aux couleurs de l'arc-en-ciel.

description.fr: Une coquille vide qui sent encore la moule pas fraîche.
description.en: An empty shell which smells of old mussels. Nice...
description.es: An empty shell which smells of old mussels. Nice...

description.fr: Accompagnées de frites, ces Moules sont succulentes. Le souci est qu'il faut pouvoir les faire cracher aux Molluskys.
description.en: Mussels like this one are delicious with fries. Good luck getting enough of them for a meal though - you'll have to battle a whole horde of Molluskies!
description.es: Mussels like this one are delicious with fries. Good luck getting enough of them for a meal though - you'll have to battle a whole horde of Molluskies!

description.fr: Ne vous a-t-on jamais dit que vous avez un petit coeur de Kralamour ?
description.en: Has anyone ever told you that you have the heart of a Kralove?
description.es: Has anyone ever told you that you have the heart of a Kralove?
description.pt: Has anyone ever told you that you have the heart of a Kralove?

description.fr: Retirée du Kralaboss, cette corne ne devrait plus causer de décharge... Néamoins, méfiez-vous de la joute qui dort !
description.en: Once removed from the Kralaboss, this horn should behave itself... Still, as they say, never trust a sleeping Mollusky.
description.es: Once removed from the Kralaboss, this horn should behave itself... Still, as they say, never trust a sleeping Mollusky.
description.pt: Once removed from the Kralaboss, this horn should behave itself... Still, as they say, never trust a sleeping Mollusky.

description.fr: Cette dent de Skouale est très aiguisée, c'est une dent de la mer alors méfiez-vous !
description.en: Ever since this Selachii Tooth landed a cameo in the cult film Jaw, it won't stop bragging about it and humming the theme tune.
description.es: Ever since this Selachii Tooth landed a cameo in the cult film Jaw, it won't stop bragging about it and humming the theme tune.
description.pt: Ever since this Selachii Tooth landed a cameo in the cult film Jaw, it won't stop bragging about it and humming the theme tune.

description.fr: La peau de Skouale est connue pour être très épaisse. Elle également grasse, très lourde et très glissante.
description.en: Selachii Skin is known for being very thick. Unfortunately, it's also very greasy, very heavy and very slippery.
description.es: Selachii Skin is known for being very thick. Unfortunately, it's also very greasy, very heavy and very slippery.
description.pt: Selachii Skin is known for being very thick. Unfortunately, it's also very greasy, very heavy and very slippery.

description.fr: On ne sait toujours pas à l'heure actuelle si ce sang provient d'un Skouale ou de ses victimes.
description.en: Tests are underway to investigate whether this blood came from a Selachii or from one of its victims.
description.es: Tests are underway to investigate whether this blood came from a Selachii or from one of its victims.
description.pt: Tests are underway to investigate whether this blood came from a Selachii or from one of its victims.

description.fr: Il vous rendra aussi fort qu'une dent de la mer.
description.en: For healthy jaws.
description.es: For healthy jaws.
description.pt: For healthy jaws.

description.fr: Autant vous dire que vous serez le roi de la blague avec cette nageoire en guise de déguisement de requin dans les mers de Sufokia !
description.en: You thought this would be a great way to become 'the funny guy' at beach parties; all it really does is turn off light switches when you're least expecting it.
description.es: You thought this would be a great way to become 'the funny guy' at beach parties; all it really does is turn off light switches when you're least expecting it.
description.pt: You thought this would be a great way to become 'the funny guy' at beach parties; all it really does is turn off light switches when you're least expecting it.

description.fr: Ces Fées d'artifice illuminent le ciel de petits cœurs et d'amour.
description.en: These Fairyworks illuminate the sky with love and small hearts.
description.es: These Fairyworks illuminate the sky with love and small hearts.
description.pt: These Fairyworks illuminate the sky with love and small hearts.

description.fr: Souple et solide, ce cuir est d'une qualité bien supérieure à celle d'un vulgaire cuir de Bouftou ! Il faudrait être myope comme une Phorreuse pour ne pas voir la différence !
description.en: Supple and strong, the leather is of much higher quality than ordinary Gobball leather! You'd have to be as blind as a Drheller not to see the difference!
description.es: Supple and strong, the leather is of much higher quality than ordinary Gobball leather! You'd have to be as blind as a Drheller not to see the difference!
description.pt: Supple and strong, the leather is of much higher quality than ordinary Gobball leather! You'd have to be as blind as a Drheller not to see the difference!

description.fr: Cette dent est utilisée par les Enutrofs pour protéger leurs filons. Si vous en voyez une accrochée sur la paroi d’une mine, le message est clair : défense de forer !
description.en: This tooth is used by Enutrofs to protect their mineral veins. If you see one hanging on the wall of a mine, the message is clear: no drilling!
description.es: This tooth is used by Enutrofs to protect their mineral veins. If you see one hanging on the wall of a mine, the message is clear: no drilling!

description.fr: Ce Phorreur a le cœur sur la main. Enfin... sur la vôtre.

description.es: Who would have thought that the hair of an animal that likes to wallow in its own muck would be so silky?
